concepts.name: artificial intelligence tutor
concepts.definition: An artificial intelligence tutor is a system designed to provide educational support.

concepts.name: questions
concepts.definition: Inquiries or requests for information posed by users.

concepts.name: collection of course documents
concepts.definition: A set of materials related to specific courses.

concepts.name: tutor
concepts.definition: An artificial intelligence tutor that answers questions about a collection of course documents.

concepts.name: language model
concepts.definition: A tool used by the tutor to generate explanations.

concepts.name: explanations
concepts.definition: Content generated by a language model using the tutor.

concepts.name: fluent wording
concepts.definition: The quality of the generated explanations produced by the tutor.

concepts.name: factual accuracy

concepts.name: parameters of the language model
concepts.definition: Adjustable settings within the language model that are modified during training using examples from a training dataset.

concepts.name: training dataset
concepts.definition: A collection of examples used for training.

concepts.name: validation dataset
concepts.definition: A separate validation dataset supports model selection and the choice of training settings.

concepts.definition: The process of choosing appropriate models or configurations supported by a validation dataset to determine training settings.

concepts.name: choice of training settings
concepts.definition: the choice of training settings

concepts.name: held out test dataset
concepts.definition: A dataset reserved for evaluation after model choices are finalized.

concepts.name: performance

concepts.definition: Decisions regarding model selection and training settings made prior to testing.

concepts.definition: A component that divides an input passage into tokens.

concepts.definition: The text data provided for processing.

concepts.definition: A specific location in the sequence of tokens within a model's input.

concepts.name: restriction

concepts.name: model parameters

concepts.name: held out test results

concepts.name: selected passages

concepts.name: making revised course material available
